subject: Quantivo production: sudden latency and error-rate spike — C-suite brief requested
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@quantivo.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: support@quantivo.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High error rate & p99 latency spikes in production (Quantivo)

Hi Jasmine / Monica,

We're seeing a sudden spike in errors and tail latency across our checkout traffic that started ~08:55 PT. 5xx rate increased from ~0.1% to 4.3% and p99 latency jumped to ~3.2s (normally ~380ms). This is impacting ~12% of checkout attempts.

Quick context: we are on Redwood hosted model endpoint redwood-gpt-7b-q at model variant v202607-quantivo. Nothing changed on our side in the last 24h. We can see a sharp rise in inference errors (RPC timeouts) aligning with request bursts at ~08:52.

What we can attach: sample traces and aggregated error frequencies for the last 20 minutes (attached: quantivo_error_snapshot.json).

We need an urgent alignment call with your ops/eng team to triage and get this to a mitigation state. Can you confirm availability for an immediate bridge?

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Senior SRE, Quantivo
alex.moreno@quantivo.com
Attachment: quantivo_error_snapshot.json

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@quantivo.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@quantivo.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High error rate & p99 latency spikes in production (Quantivo)

Alex — thanks for the quick flag and the snapshot. We’re on it.

Immediate plan:
- Stand up a bridge now: Zoom link https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (joining in 3m).
- Engineering triage (Laura) will collect request traces and identify whether this is infra autoscale or model runtime.
- Monica will keep Quantivo execs updated and surface customer impact.
- I’ll coordinate an initial mitigation (scale & fallback) and post status to this thread.

Attaching a short checklist for the initial triage we’ll run.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: High error rate & p99 latency spikes in production (Quantivo)

Joining bridge — quick notes from initial look:
- Observed behavior matches a delayed autoscaler loop combined with transient KV cache pressure on the serving nodes. There was a short window where new KVs pushed memory high and replicas didn't scale fast enough.
- If we suspect autoscale lag, two immediate mitigations: force scale +14 GPUs for the affected pool; or fallback to a lower-context model variant (redwood-gpt-7b-q-fallback) while we clean caches.
- Request traces: Alex, please forward 5 sample request IDs (headers + timestamps).

I'm asking infra to run the immediate scale command now. If scale command doesn't come up within 90s we switch traffic to fallback variant.

Laura Bennett
Head of Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: scale-plan.txt

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Quantivo incident update — mitigation applied, next steps

Alex / Priya — final update for the incident window: thank you for working with the team on the bridge.

What we did:
- Forced scale applied to the serving pool at 09:42 PT on 27-Jul; additional 12 GPUs brought online.
- Temporary traffic shift to fallback model variant for high-concurrency routes from 09:44–10:05 PT.
- KV caches were cycled and GC performed on affected nodes; error rate returned to baseline within ~18 minutes of the scale action.

Status now:
- 5xx rate has dropped back to 0.15% (pre-incident baseline 0.1–0.3% range). p99 latency is at 420ms and stable.
- We’ve marked the incident as mitigated at 10:10 PT on 27-Jul and are keeping a monitored window for 24 hours.

Next steps / commitments:
- Post-mortem: preliminary findings in 72 hours; full RCA within 7 business days (JIRA INF-4823).
- Compensation: we will propose an SLO credit if the incident duration exceeds thresholds; Monica will follow up on specifics.
- Customer comms: formal incident brief + timeline to be shared to Quantivo execs within 2 business hours.

If you see any regression or residual errors please reopen the bridge with the same Zoom link.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
